title: Fix event-bus per-emit forks, malformed timestamps, and run-status self-trigger loop
goal: Reduce per-event spawns to O(1) jq calls, fix malformed ISO timestamps in map-unit work units, and break the run-status comment sidecar's self-trigger loop and redundant PATCH loop

steps.description: Write test-first: timestamp malformation regression test. Verifies that emitting an event with ZBUILD_PLATFORM=linux (as a map work unit would set) on the host still produces a well-formed ISO 8601 timestamp with no literal '%3N'. Must fail RED at the merge base because the current code reads ZBUILD_PLATFORM to choose the date format, causing BSD date to emit '%3N' literally on macOS hosts running linux-target map units.

Write test-first: two new SPECs in the run-status comment loop test. SPEC-6: a sidecar whose only new events are its own render's redaction.applied must produce no second render and no second PATCH — the watcher must not re-wake on its own writes. SPEC-7: rsc_upsert (via rsc_flush) makes no gh PATCH request when the rendered body is identical to the previously-sent body. Both must fail RED at the merge base.

Fix eb_emit_event: build payload in one jq invocation instead of one per key=val pair. Accumulate key/val pairs as --arg entries in an array, then call jq -n '$ARGS.named' once. This eliminates N-1 jq forks per emit (N = payload field count, typically 3-8). Also replace _eb_sql_escape's 'printf | sed' with bash parameter expansion '${1//\'/'\''\''}'  to remove the sed fork per escaped field (six calls per SQLite-enabled emit). Envelope call (jq -cn) at line 206 is already a single call and is unchanged.

Fix portable timestamp: replace 'if [[ "$ZBUILD_PLATFORM" == "macos" ]]' with an OSTYPE-based host check. Add a _eb_host_is_mac helper that reads $OSTYPE (bash built-in, no fork) — true when OSTYPE starts with 'darwin'. The fix keeps ADR-009 §6: map work units continue to export ZBUILD_PLATFORM=<target> for plugins; the host clock format now uses a separate variable so the two are no longer coupled.

Fix rsc_tail_loop self-trigger: after rsc_flush returns, re-read the current file size of events.jsonl and set last_size to that value. This absorbs the redaction.applied event(s) written by apply_scope_redaction during the flush, so the next poll sees size == last_size and dirty stays 0. Also set ZBUILD_CURRENT_STAGE="run-status-comment" at the top of rsc_main (before rsc_flush is ever called) so every event emitted by the sidecar, including redaction.applied, carries stage attribution.

Fix rsc_flush to skip unchanged-body PATCHes: before calling rsc_upsert, compare the rendered body_file against the previously-sent body stored at $state_dir/status-comment-body-prev.txt using 'cmp -s'. If identical, remove body_file and return 0. On a successful rsc_upsert call, atomically copy body_file to the prev file. This makes rsc_upsert a no-op for unchanged renders, eliminating the ~1,476 redundant PATCHes seen in the #1802 run.

Lower FORK_BUDGET in fork-budget-test.sh to reflect the reduced per-emit fork count (measure after steps 3-4 land). Add ADR-065 §5 amendment note to ADR-065-process-budget.md documenting that the event bus per-emit processes named in §5 are now removed, and add an ## Enforced by section naming the enforcement tests. Remove ADR-065-process-budget.md from config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt (the baseline only shrinks).

notes: Gaps and assumptions: (1) FORK_BUDGET exact new value cannot be determined without running the parity fixture after the implementation lands — step-7 must measure it then set the number. The plan sets the budget ratchet as the last step so measurement is against the fully-patched tree. (2) The _eb_sql_escape bash-substitution form '${1//\'/\'\''}'  is documented in the code as having been flagged by Copilot for the escaped-inside-double-quotes edge case. The implementer should verify the expansion is correct in bash (a unit test with a string containing a single quote is a sufficient check). If it proves unreliable, 'tr' is the safe fallback ('printf "%s" "$1" | tr "'" "''"') at the cost of one fork — still better than sed. (3) The sidecar stage attribution (ZBUILD_CURRENT_STAGE="run-status-comment") is set in rsc_main before any emit; this covers rsc_tail_loop and rsc_flush. If rsc_outbound_body is called outside rsc_main (e.g., the --once path), it too inherits the exported value. (4) The unchanged-body prev file grows to ~60 KB per render; this is acceptable for a state-dir file and is cleaned up with the run's state directory. (5) The cmp -s approach for unchanged-body detection adds one fork per potential PATCH, which is negligible compared to the gh network call it prevents. (6) The self-trigger fix (re-reading size after flush) is minimal and does not suppress redaction.applied entirely — the event is still emitted once per genuine render and carries stage attribution after step-5. This satisfies 'attributed or no longer emitted per render' in the acceptance criteria. (7) ADR-065 is currently in config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt (line 62), so the absence of 'Enforced by' does not currently fail lint. Step-7 removes it from the baseline, which requires the Enforced by section to be present and name real test files — this is a hard dependency: step-7 must only run after step-1 and step-2 have created those test files.
